name: airport-authority
description: Airport Authority: a session-continuity and project-lifecycle suite for Claude Code. 13 skills (flight-deck, hangar, preflight, flight-engineer, bible-keeper, canon-keeper, session-relaunch, cross-session-brief, beads-team-setup, and bundled helpers), 7 commands (/takeoff, /landing, /alleyoop, /slamdunk, /tower, /airport, /flight-engineer), and 4 hooks that stamp session state, warn on a missed /takeoff, and nudge /landing, takeoff-before-compaction, and long-session checkpoints.
